title: Cxrrvptxd's From The Fog
description: Cxrrvptxd's From The Fog is a terrifying Minecraft horror experience designed to keep players on edge every second they survive. Explore a world consumed by darkness, dense fog, and supernatural entities that stalk you from the shadows.
body:
The fog has returned... and you're not alone.

Step into a corrupted world where ancient horrors roam the forests, caves, and darkness beyond your torchlight. Every sound could be a warning. Every shadow could be watching. Every cave could be your last.

Cxrrvptxd's From The Fog combines some of the most terrifying horror creature mods available to create a survival experience unlike any other. Encounter mysterious stalkers lurking in the mist, hear unsettling noises echoing through caves, and survive against creatures that seem to learn your every move.
